notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the token Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer.
Repeat.
